div.span:
Who has access (restricted)?
SysAdmin-Builder (build and test),
DBA-Admin (test databases), External-Builder (migration consultants,

span.style: font-family: "Comic Sans MS"; background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(#000000, var(--ge-light-color, #ffffff));

div.span:
No connection to Production, and no live data. A mistake here cannot reach live systems (AS-01).
Changes reach Production only through an approved change request, never through a connection.
